create_logger: create a logger with file and console handlers using create_logger(filepath, rank)
create_log_formatter: create a LogFormatter instance that formats log records with elapsed time and level name
reset_logger_time: reset the logger elapsed time by calling logger.reset_time() after create_logger
review_LogFormatter_format: review the LogFormatter format method to understand how it prefixes log messages with level, timestamp, and elapsed time
test_create_logger: test the create_logger function with a filepath and rank to verify file and console handlers are configured
